items.source: IdentifierAccessor that is aware of the target bean to obtain the identifier from so that it can generate a more meaningful exception in case of an absent identifier and a call to TargetAwareIdentifierAccessor.getRequiredIdentifier().
items.translation: 一个能够感知目标 Bean 以从中获取标识符的IdentifierAccessor，以便在标识符缺失且调用TargetAwareIdentifierAccessor.getRequiredIdentifier()时能够生成更具意义的异常。
